title: At Risk Customers counts days in the location's own time zone
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. Admin holds every permission, including Reports, so Reports and Dashboard both show in the top menu.
  2. In the top bar choose a location with several months of invoice history (many customers, invoices going back more than a year), e.g. the main QA location. At Risk needs old invoices, which cannot be back-dated by hand.
  3. Note the location's time zone: Settings > Locations > open the location (write down the time zone it shows).
  4. Have a second device (a second computer or a phone) whose clock is set to a time zone far from the location's (e.g. 8 or more hours apart), signed in as the same or another user with the Reports permission and the same location selected.
  5. Click Dashboard in the top menu, then View details under the At Risk Customers tile. The table shows Customer, Last Invoice Date, Lifetime Invoices and Revenue (12 Mo).
custom_steps:
1. On your main device, set the At Risk window pill to 30 Days and write down the headline. Repeat for 60, 90, 120 and 180 Days.
  2. On the second device open Dashboard and read the At Risk headline for the same five windows.
  3. In the table on the main device pick one customer and count the calendar days from their Last Invoice Date to today's date at the location (not your own date).
  4. Read the headline again at the end of the shop's working day for the same windows, without making or undoing any invoice in between.
  5. If your working hours reach the location's midnight, read the headline a few minutes before and a few minutes after midnight at the location.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Both devices show the same At Risk count for every window, even though their clocks are in different time zones.
  • The day count uses the location's date: a customer is listed only when the days from their Last Invoice Date to the location's today are at least the chosen window.
  • The count does not change during the shop's working day (morning and evening readings match).
  • Across the location's midnight the count may change, and only then. If you cannot be working at the location's midnight, write "midnight change not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9577 (S5); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S5 (S5-R15). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 09_AtRisk_After, 09_AtRisk_Window.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R15: “Two parts of the at-risk definition are fixed here so the count cannot be read two ways. "Some revenue in the last twelve months" means revenue greater than $0.00 over the trailing twelve months, measured the way the Revenue tile measures revenue: invoice subtotals before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos. A customer whose twelve-month revenue is exactly $0.00, or is negative because credits exceeded sales, does not satisfy this part of the test, though they can still qualify on the two-or-more-lifetime-invoices part. "At least the selected number of days old" is counted in whole calendar days in the selected workplace's timezone, from the date of the customer's most recent invoice to the current date. The count therefore changes at the shop's own midnight and is stable through the shop's working day, and two people viewing the same workplace from different places see the same number.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
